subject.why: Clearly depicts a grand stone manor house with chimneys, steps, and an upstairs escape ladder.

category.why: Follows Category 4 with a solid ground band of lawn and drive beneath a simple, bright sky.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, or characters present.

framing.why: Centred composition with solid silhouette and adequate margins around the roofline and sides.

colour.why: Warm, sunny palette with honey stone cleanly separated from the blue sky and green grass.

detail.why: Volumes are chunky and simplified without distracting micro-textures or excessive clutter.

style.why: Render matches the references with smooth bevels, satin finish, and clean 3D forms.
